description: Takes the text of an offer (or the last negotiated version) and the text of the contract that is about to be signed, and optionally a list of agreed points, one per line. Compares the figures, deadlines and dates per topic (price, payment and discount, term and termination, liability, penalty, warranty, non-solicitation, confidentiality, jurisdiction, travel expenses): match, different, in the offer but missing in the contract, only in the contract. Each agreed point is checked against the contract. Ends with a ready message to the other side and the next step. To compare two versions of the same contract use compare_contracts. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

agreed.description: Optional: points agreed in the negotiation, one per line, for example 'Payment terms 30 days net'.

contract_text.description: Full text of the contract to be signed.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

offer_text.description: Full text of the offer or of the last negotiated version.

name: compare_offer_to_contract
title: Offer against contract: is what was negotiated really in the contract? Figures and deadlines per topic side by side, agreed points ticked off, message to the other side
